`pmset-discharging.txt`, `ioreg-internal-only.txt` and `bluetooth-none-connected.json` were recorded on a MacBook (names replaced,
addresses and serial numbers removed). `ioreg-magic.txt` and `bluetooth-connected.json` are constructed in the same formats,
because no Magic device or AirPods was connected when recording.

`bluetooth-airpods.json` was recorded with AirPods Pro connected (owner name removed, no addresses or serial numbers). It has
the AirPods and the nameless Bluetooth LE beacon macOS lists for their case.
